mapper.insert: INSERT INTO b_review_ai (gmt_create, gmt_modify, service_order_id, question, admin_user_id, review_results) VALUES (now(), now(), #{serviceOrderId}, #{question}, #{adminUserId}, #{reviewResults});
mapper.select: SELECT id, gmt_create, gmt_modify, service_order_id, question, admin_user_id, review_results FROM b_review_ai WHERE id = #{id, jdbcType=INTEGER}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM b_review_ai WHERE id = #{id, jdbcType=INTEGER}
